player.setUpDiscDesc: Choose the image (.iso or .chd) of your own disc. OpenRAC never downloads a game.
player.notPlayedYet: This game cannot be played yet. You can set your disc up now, ready for when it can.
player.notPlayableYetDesc2: so it runs natively on your computer. Play appears here when it is ready
player.playableStatus1: ; your disc is already set up for it.
player.playableStatus2: . You can set your disc up now, so it is ready too.

saveManager.savesDesc: Your saves show here once you have played and saved.

differences.differencesDesc: What this PC version does otherwise than the PlayStation 2 game, and why.
differences.differenceGameFixesDesc: On, the port's fix; off, the game plays as on a PlayStation 2. The game's Options menu has the same switches.
differences.differenceGuardDesc: Where a PlayStation 2 carried on unnoticed but a PC would crash. Always on: off would only bring the crash back.
differences.differencePortDesc: What comes with the game being a PC program.

modsText.modsDesc: Add mods, switch them on, and play.
modsText.earlyLine: Its levels open in Godot and you can make texture and model packs. Packing level edits and playing come later.
modsText.noneTitle: No mods for this game yet
modsText.noneLine: Mods arrive once the level editor can read its levels.
modsText.linkPlaceholder: Paste a mod's link, like openrac.dev/mods/lock-strafe
modsText.drop: or drop a .zip or folder on this page
modsText.packsEmpty: None yet. Add one above, or make your own in the Level editor or Models and textures.

settings.gamesFolderDesc: The folder with your PlayStation 2 disc images (.iso). OpenRAC finds its games in it.
settings.installFolderDesc: Where your games are set up from your discs. A few GB per game.
settings.themeDesc: The launcher's colours. Its accent is the game's.
settings.compactLayoutDesc: A game's name and its Play button side by side.
settings.showInDiscordDesc: Your status says when you are playing.
settings.multiplayerNameDesc: What other players see in online mods. 3 to 16 letters, digits and underscores.
settings.languageDesc: Choose the language of the app.

folderPrompt.androidDesc: Choose the image of your own disc (.iso or .chd) from this device's storage. It is copied into the app, a few GB, and the game is set up from it. OpenRAC never downloads a game.
folderPrompt.pcDesc: Choose the folder with your disc images (.iso). OpenRAC finds the Ratchet & Clank games in it and sets them up. Nothing is copied off your computer, and OpenRAC never downloads a game.
